GUJARAT POLICE - CITIZEN e-COMPLAINT (COPY)

Complaint No: 445/2026
Police Station: Vastrapur, Ahmedabad City
Date of Registration: 20/07/2026, 10:05 AM
Type: Theft of articles from vehicle

Complainant: Tanvi Joshi, R/o Judges Bungalow Road, Bodakdev, Ahmedabad

Details of complaint:
Complainant states that on 19/07/2026 she parked her Kia Sonet car (Regn GJ01RV8123, white) in the open parking area near Alpha One Mall, Vastrapur at about 1815 hrs and went inside the mall. On returning at about 2100 hrs she found that her laptop bag kept on the rear seat was missing. The bag contained one Dell Latitude laptop belonging to her employer, charger, documents and personal items. The car was found parked in the same place. No visible damage to the car, windows intact. Complainant is unsure whether the car was locked properly.

Stolen property: 1) Dell Latitude 7440 laptop (approx Rs. 1,10,000) 2) laptop bag with charger, documents, misc (approx Rs. 14,000)

This is a system generated copy of the e-complaint for the complainant's record. Investigation as per procedure.

documents.title: Customer incident description (email)
documents.text:
From: tanvi.j.amd@mailbox.example
To: claims@nimbusgeneral.example
Subject: Claim - theft from my car GJ01RV8123

Hello,

I want to raise a claim under my car policy NMS-PC-260987. On 19th July evening I parked my Sonet in the open parking near Alpha One mall around 6:15 pm and went for shopping and dinner. When I came back around 9 pm, my laptop bag which I had kept on the back seat was gone.

The strange part is the car was locked when I came back and there is no damage at all - no broken glass, nothing, not a scratch. Honestly I am not 100% sure if I locked it when I left, I usually press the lock button while walking away but that day I was on a call. Maybe someone opened it and locked it back, or maybe it was unlocked, I don't know.

The laptop is my office laptop (Dell Latitude) worth around 1.1 lakh and my office is asking me to recover it through insurance. I filed an online police complaint the next morning (no. 445/2026, Vastrapur PS). The car itself is absolutely fine and with me.

Please tell me what else you need to process this claim for the laptop and bag (total approx Rs 1,24,000).

Thanks,
Tanvi Joshi
